metadata.title: Ordinary Banach–Mazur rigidity of von Neumann algebras
metadata.description: For every fixed complex von Neumann algebra M, an algebra-dependent positive ordinary complex Banach–Mazur threshold ensures that every von Neumann algebra N within that threshold is Jordan *-isomorphic to M. The same threshold works for the canonical preduals. This consequence uses OpenAI's family-295 ordinary bounded self-coefficient Hochschild vanishing theorem at pinned commit adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a and Roydor's established geometric machinery. Roydor announced the general conditional implication in 2020, while his published Theorem 1.2 assumes separable predual. The note gives an explicit proof extension using deformation stability on two fixed source algebras and reconstruction of odd finite type-I summands from full abelian projections. The cohomology input, multiplication-stability mechanism, geometric estimates and predual reduction are attributed inherited results; no firstness, independently new cohomology solution, universal numerical threshold or reproduced formal verification is claimed. AI tools were used extensively in research, proof development, drafting and verification. Internal adversarial AI audits are not conventional human peer review, and the preprint has not undergone conventional human refereeing. The PDF is separately downloadable; the source supplement contains the standalone TeX source, precise dependency and priority records, proof audits and finite exact mechanism checks, with unchanged Apache-2.0 upstream material retaining its original license. Primary sources: https://github.com/openai/math/tree/adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a/preprints/Vanishing-of-higher-bounded-Hochschild-cohomology-September-23-2026 ; https://doi.org/10.1142/S1793525321500151 ; https://arxiv.org/abs/1108.1970v2 .
